plan.title: Prevent deletion of the only product row

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Provide the mandatory event title for a create test.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the specified CYLINDER product as the only line item.
Set the only row's requested quantity to 10.
Select the specified delivery location for the only row.

args.goal: On the single-row product sheet, hover the only row, click its bin/delete control, and stop when the app displays the refusal that the last product row cannot be removed.

steps.note: The row's bin icon is not exposed by a catalog step, so perform the exact deletion attempt on the buyer screen.

args.text: At least one product is required, so the last one can't be removed.

steps.note: Assert that deleting the only product row is refused with the required message.
